title: Samsung Electronics' Quarterly Profit Surges 180 Times: AI Storage Holds the Line, Phones and Home Appliances Are Losing Money

content_html:
Samsung Electronics announced its Q2 2026 financial results on July 30. Benefiting from the surge in both volume and price of AI storage chips, the company's total revenue reached 171.5 trillion South Korean won (about 805 billion Chinese yuan), a 130% year-on-year increase, setting a new record for a single quarter; operating profit soared to 89.5 trillion South Korean won (about 420.1 billion Chinese yuan), surging by 1813.8% year-on-year. Driven by the global AI boom, Samsung's sales and operating profit have set records for three consecutive quarters.

Semiconductors contributed more than 99% of the profits, with HBM as the absolute engine

Looking at the business segments, Samsung's semiconductor division reported sales of 127.5 trillion South Korean won and operating profit of 89.2 trillion South Korean won, driving almost all of the company's earnings. The share of server storage chips in revenue reached a new high, with large-scale shipments of high-performance HBM4 and the start of delivery of HBM4E samples. Samsung expects continued increased capital spending on AI infrastructure and widespread adoption of intelligent agents in the second half of the year, leading to further growth in demand for server DRAM, enterprise SSDs, and HBM.

However, outside of semiconductors, the situation is different. The mobile phone business generated a total revenue of 33.2 trillion South Korean won but recorded an operating loss of 70 billion South Korean won. Although flagship phones drove revenue, component costs remained tight. The TV and white goods business generated a total revenue of 14.5 trillion South Korean won, also recording a small loss. The profit contribution rate from the semiconductor department has exceeded 99%, transforming Samsung's profit structure into a "single-engine" model.

Profit surged but market value dropped by 40%, with a 'buy the expectation, sell the fact' scenario unfolding

Despite the impressive financial figures, Samsung's stock price has fallen by 40% from its peak on June 1, with the current market value around 1327 trillion South Korean won. This month alone, the South Korean KOSPI index has declined nearly 29%, surpassing the record set during the 1997 Asian financial crisis. The South Korean Ministry of Finance has urgently increased restrictions on leveraged products.

According to researcher Quan Xiaoxing from the University of International Business and Economics, the performance boom driven by AI had already been fully anticipated by the market, representing a typical "buy the expectation, sell the fact" scenario. Deeper concerns lie in investors' anxiety about whether the capital expenditure cycle for AI chips is nearing its peak, which could trigger a reversal in the semiconductor industry cycle. Additionally, the ongoing losses in non-core businesses such as mobile phones and home appliances have raised questions about the company's long-term health. Furthermore, previous strike agreements mainly benefited high-profit departments such as memory chips, with a near 100-fold difference in bonuses within the same company, exposing deep-seated governance issues.

content_html_zh:
三星电子于7月30日公布了2026年第二季度财务业绩。 受益于AI存储芯片量价双涨，该公司总营收达到171.5万亿韩元（约合人民币8050亿元），同比增长130%，创下单季度新纪录；营业利润飙升至89.5万亿韩元（约合人民币4201亿元），同比飙升1813.8%。 在全球人工智能热潮的推动下，三星的销售额和营业利润连续三个季度创下纪录。

半导体贡献99%以上利润，HBM为绝对引擎

从业务板块来看，三星半导体部门销售额为127.5万亿韩元，营业利润为89.2万亿韩元，几乎带动了该公司全部盈利。 服务器存储芯片营收占比再创新高，高性能HBM4大规模出货，HBM4E样品开始交付。 三星预计，下半年人工智能基础设施的资本支出将持续增加，智能代理将得到广泛采用，从而导致服务器 DRAM、企业级 SSD 和 HBM 的需求进一步增长。

然而，在半导体之外，情况有所不同。 手机业务总收入为33.2万亿韩元，但营业亏损为700亿韩元。 尽管旗舰手机带动了收入，但零部件成本仍然紧张。 电视和白色家电业务总收入为14.5万亿韩元，也录得小幅亏损。 半导体部门的利润贡献率已超过99%，将三星的利润结构转变为“单引擎”模式。

利润飙升但市值下跌40%，“买预期，卖事实”的局面正在上演

尽管财务数据令人印象深刻，但三星股价较6月1日的峰值已下跌40%，目前市值约为1327万亿韩元。 仅本月，韩国KOSPI指数就下跌了近29%，超过了1997年亚洲金融危机期间创下的纪录。 韩国财政部紧急加大对杠杆产品的限制。

对外经济贸易大学研究员全晓星表示，人工智能带动的业绩热潮已经被市场充分预期，是典型的“买预期，卖事实”的场景。 更深层次的担忧在于投资者担心AI芯片的资本支出周期是否已接近顶峰，这可能引发半导体行业周期的逆转。 此外，手机和家电等非核心业务的持续亏损也引发了人们对公司长期健康状况的质疑。 此外，此前的罢工协议主要受益于存储芯片等高利润部门，同一家公司内部奖金相差近百倍，暴露出深层次的治理问题。
